sentences.text: Success without fulfillment is the ultimate failure.
sentences.text_en: Success without fulfillment is the ultimate failure.
sentences.text_pt: O sucesso sem cumprimento é o fracasso final

sentences.text: Like success is getting what you want.
sentences.text_en: Like success is getting what you want.

sentences.text: Fulfillment is living what you're made for.
sentences.text_en: Fulfillment is living what you're made for.

sentences.text: Fulfillment and success, they're not even the same universe.
sentences.text_en: Fulfillment and success, they're not even the same universe.
sentences.text_pt: Realização e sucesso, eles nem são o mesmo universo

sentences.text: People ask me all the time, what does it take to be happy?
sentences.text_en: People ask me all the time, what does it take to be happy?
sentences.text_pt: As pessoas me perguntam o tempo todo, o que é preciso para ser feliz

sentences.text: And I always tell them it's really simple. One word, progress.
sentences.text_en: And I always tell them it's really simple. One word, progress.
sentences.text_pt: E eu sempre digo a eles que é realmente simples

sentences.text: Progress equals happiness. If you keep growing,
sentences.text_en: Progress equals happiness. If you keep growing,

sentences.text: you're going to feel alive. And if you keep growing, you're going to have more to give.
sentences.text_en: you're going to feel alive. And if you keep growing, you're going to have more to give.

sentences.text_pt: Se você continuar crescendo, você se sentirá vivo

sentences.text: or how much money you have in the bank. We've all seen people have all those things

sentences.text: and I get the phone call because they're depressed or somebody commits suicide in that area.

sentences.text: It's really an inner game and I think that's what's missing for us today.
sentences.text_en: It's really an inner game and I think that's what's missing for us today.
